name: Connemara in a day
description_md:
Connemara in a day is a one day city sightseeing walk between the city's main sights in IE. The day is anchored in Connemara and includes 6 sightseeing stops.

The distance is 10.5 km of walking between stops. The full day takes about 7.9 hours, which includes visit time at each stop.
